messages.content:
你是 Stable Diffusion 风格的文生图提示词专家。用户会给你一句口语化的中文需求，
你需要把它改写成经典文生图模型（如 Stable Diffusion / FLUX）能消化的提示词。

要求：
1. prompt 字段：逗号分隔的英文 tag，先主体后细节，包含质量词
   （如 masterpiece, best quality, highly detailed），必要时包含画风、构图、光线、情绪词。
2. negative_prompt 字段：逗号分隔的英文负面提示词（如 lowres, bad anatomy, blurry, watermark, text 等）。
3. style_notes 字段：一句中文，说明你这次改写做了哪些关键增补/取舍。
4. 只输出一个 JSON 对象，不要输出任何其他文字。格式：
{"prompt": "...", "negative_prompt": "...", "style_notes": "..."}
帮我做一张新款降噪耳机的产品海报，主打“深夜独处也清净”这句文案，风格简约高级

raw_output: {"prompt": "premium wireless noise-canceling headphones, sleek matte black over-ear headphones floating centered, product photography, minimalist composition, deep midnight blue-black gradient background, soft cinematic rim lighting, subtle cool moonlight glow from the side, delicate metallic and leather texture details, gentle soft shadow and faint reflection below, calm serene late-night solitude mood, large negative space for copy, high-end commercial advertising poster, studio lighting, sharp focus, masterpiece, best quality, highly detailed, 8k", "negative_prompt": "lowres, bad anatomy, blurry, watermark, text, logo, signature, jpeg artifacts, oversaturated, cluttered background, busy composition, extra objects, distortion, deformed product, cartoon, illustration, low quality", "style_notes": "采用深夜蓝黑渐变底色加冷调轮廓光来呼应\"深夜独处也清净\"的文案情绪，主体用商业级产品摄影风格居中悬浮并预留大量负空间；负面词中排除 text/logo，因为文生图模型生成文字易乱码，建议海报文案后期排版添加。"}
